headline: Healthpeak Properties Beats Revenue Estimates Despite Earnings Miss
summary: Healthpeak Properties reported third-quarter earnings that missed expectations by $0.03, while revenue topped consensus estimates.
why: Healthpeak Properties is a healthcare real estate investment trust investing in laboratories, outpatient medical facilities, and continuing care retirement communities.

impacts.name: Healthpeak Properties Inc
impacts.why: An earnings miss is negative, but a revenue beat provides offsetting support for the equity valuation.
